messages:
sam_customer: hey, we're seeing intermittent 500s and weird embed cache behavior since yesterday. some requests return cached vectors that are the wrong dimension and some batched calls fail with "dimension mismatch". :confused:

sam_customer: symptoms: low-latency cache hits reported in logs but the app later errors when verifying vector length. spike in user errors ~15:00 UTC.

sam_customer: snippet from our logs: 
CACHE_LOOKUP key=acme:projectA:ctx123:model=embed-mid-v1 hit=true dim=1536
CACHE_RETURN key=acme:projectA:ctx123 model=embed-mid-v1 vector_len=1536
BATCH_EMBED ERROR batch_id=xxx dims=[1536,1024] -> "dimension mismatch"

alice_support: hi @sam_customer :wave: sorry for the trouble. quick q: did you recently change model or enable any SDK caching optimizations? also can you share a minimal repro (curl or python) and the exact request headers?

sam_customer: we didn't touch app code except updating the SDK minor version last week. we do pass a tenant prefix header X-embed-prefix and also pass model=name in body. curl repro below (sanitized):

curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "X-embed-prefix: acme:projectA" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"embed-mid","input":["a","b"]}'

sam_customer: when we send a mixed batch (some items from one tenant, some from another) we see cache hits for the wrong tenant's key sometimes.

alice_support: thanks, that's helpful. can you enable the debug header on a failing request so we can see server-side cache decisions? add header: X-Cache-Debug: true and paste the response. also can you confirm if your requests ever include trailing whitespace in the prefix or inconsistent casing?

sam_customer: repro with debug header:
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Cache-Debug: true
Body: {"cache_hits":[{"key":"acme:projectA:sha1(...)","model":"embed-mid-v1","hit":true,"dim":1536}], "result":[...], "note":"batch_verify_failed"}

ben_eng: pinging from infra. quick theory: we recently rolled a routing change that allows auto-fallback to a smaller model variant when capacity constrained (embed-mid-v1 -> embed-lite-v2). If cache keys don't include model-version, a prefix reuse optimization can return an entry for the older model dim (1536) while the batch contains items routed to lite (1024). Batching then fails verify.

ben_eng: another vector: the SDK has a performance optimization that normalizes prefixes (trim + lower) but our batcher sometimes builds keys using raw item metadata. combined, this can create mismatched keys across items in the same batch.

lisa_sre: deploy-bot just posted a canary change at 2026-03-16T14:50:00Z that enabled model auto-fallback for embeds in region us-west-2. see deploy id: deploy-2026-03-16-embed-fallback. @ben_eng this sounds like it could be it.

deploy-bot: [deploy] deploy-2026-03-16-embed-fallback -> 30% traffic us-west-2 at 14:50 UTC

alice_support: ok, two-pronged cause likely: (1) cache key namespace doesn't include model-version, (2) auto-fallback changed model dims mid-batch. for immediate mitigation: set explicit model version in client (e.g., embed-mid-v1) and disable auto-fallback on the route: add header X-Prefer-Model: embed-mid-v1 or in request body set "model_version":"embed-mid-v1".

alice_support: also recommend making your prefix canonical across calls (no trailing spaces, consistent case) and include model version in the namespace you pass: e.g., X-embed-prefix: acme:projectA:embed-mid-v1.

sam_customer: thanks — do you have a quick Python snippet we can drop in to force consistent keys and reproduce locally?

ben_eng: yep, minimal example:

from redwood import Client
client = Client(token=TOKEN)
# ensure explicit model version in namespace and request
namespace = "acme:projectA:embed-mid-v1"
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="embed-mid-v1", input=["a","b"], headers={"X-embed-prefix": namespace, "X-Cache-Debug": "true"})
print(resp)

ben_eng: try sending the same payload but flip one item to a different tenant or model and you'll repro the mixed-dim hit. also try batching items individually vs combined to see behavior.

sam_customer: tried it, reproduced locally. when we include model in namespace the batch verify passes.

alice_support: great. for a longer-term fix we'll: (a) update the SDK to include model-version in cache key by default, (b) add server-side assertion to avoid returning cache entries with different dims for a batch request, and (c) add clearer docs about using tenant prefixes + model variants. i've opened internal ticket INF-3245.

ben_eng: INF-3245 notes: root cause: model-agnostic tenant prefix + routing auto-fallback + SDK prefix normalization mismatch -> cache returns entries with inconsistent dims. mitigation: namespace includes model-version + server-side dim checking + telemetry flag to track mismatched cache returns.

lisa_sre: i'll throttle the canary to 0% in us-west-2 until we push the hotfix. deploy-bot: rollback canary deploy-2026-03-16-embed-fallback for us-west-2.

deploy-bot: [rollback] deploy-2026-03-16-embed-fallback -> rollback to previous at 15:10 UTC (us-west-2)

sam_customer: thanks folks, rollback + namespace fix removed the errors. we'll update SDK pin and report back if anything else pops up. :thumbsup: 

alice_support: thanks for the quick repro and patience. we'll follow up in INF-3245 with ETA for SDK patch and server dim-check. tagging @ben_eng for follow-up. :white_check_mark:

ben_eng: follow-up action items: 1) SDK patch to append model-version to prefix (PR by EOD), 2) server-side warning metric (mismatched_cache_return) shipped in next deploy, 3) docs note about batching across tenants/models.

sam_customer: appreciated, leaving this thread open for the infra ticket link and PR.

alice_support: will post INF-3245 link and PR once available.
